description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'BuzzPostAPITest' for testing the 'BuzzPostAPI' in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes test methods for create, getAll, delete, update, and getOne API endpoints, along with data providers for some of these tests. The class extends 'EndpointIntegrationTestCase' and uses mock services and fixtures for testing API behaviors.

classes.name: BuzzPostAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the BuzzPostAPI, covering create, get, update, delete, and getOne API methods.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a Buzz post via the API using data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the testCreate method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the getAll method of the BuzzPostAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of the BuzzPostAPI, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a Buzz post via the API with data provider.

methods.name: testGetOne
